result.summary: Found 1 significant visual issue: the promotional banner text has very poor contrast and is difficult to read.

issues.description: The white headline and supporting text in the pale mint promotional banner have insufficient contrast, making the offer details appear washed out and nearly unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Use a much darker green or charcoal text color, or darken the banner background, to meet WCAG contrast requirements while preserving the promotional styling.
